findings.summary: Hero visibility is poor: the 40px mushroom is dwarfed by the oversized cloud art and the 'allin' photo backdrop, and is not locatable in several frames (50%-duty respawn blink, and falling frames are swallowed by the dark bottom band) — the hardest-to-track hero of the three platformer levels.

Blind driver lost at t≈6.3 via three void falls into the 2-tile cloud gaps (80px vs ≈72px effective hop with 0.09s cut taps); the gaps are humanly clearable with a full ≈160px jump, so this is a driver limitation, not a level defect — recorded outcome: no win, loss path exercised.

Rig win=true at t≈6.3 is actually a TRY AGAIN loss (rig counts any result overlay as a win; verdictNote present); edge windows unreached — manual probe shows the pause overlay correct ('bethany-cloudwalk — Cloudwalk · Bethany Edmonds'), state frozen while paused, no auto-pause on blur (hero kept falling while unfocused), mash Escape re-pauses, and the full loss/retry flow works: bank spent ♥×3→♥×2 with '♥ lost — 2 remaining' in the result subtext, Enter-retry resets in-level hearts to ♥♥♥ while the bank keeps the spent ♥×2; zero console/page errors.
Gold flag label 'Cloudwalk' clipped at the right canvas edge — only 'Cloudwa' visible next to the pennant.

No EN+FR controls string: level.json (single-line minified) has no meta/controls field and the in-game hint is the genre's English-only string; objective banner ('Hop the clouds… Watch the gap!') is EN-only too.
assets/logo-all.svg and assets/logo-in.svg 404 on every boot (title-screen brand images missing; rig-filtered as benign).
Audio toggle exists on the title screen (♪ button) and SOUND screen (MUSIC / SOUND FX / MASTER) but is not reachable during play — the pause menu has no audio row.
